name: SmartParallax – GPU Parallax Backgrounds & Scroll Effects
author: smartparallax

sections.description:
SmartParallax adds smooth, GPU-accelerated parallax motion to images, backgrounds, blocks and sections.
It uses a tiny, dependency-free JavaScript engine that applies optimized transforms for fluid scrolling performance — even on mobile devices.

Works with Gutenberg, Elementor, Bricks, Divi, Oxygen, WPBakery and virtually every modern WordPress theme.

Zur Demo: https://smartparallax.com/parallax-free-demo/

Highlights

  • Smooth, GPU-accelerated parallax motion
  • Background parallax using .parallax-image
  • Container parallax using .parallax-container
  • Horizontal motion using .parallax-x
  • Multi-direction parallax using .parallax-xy
  • Stop-sensitive motion using the -s modifier
  • Speed modifiers (parallax-3, parallax--05, etc.)
  • Extremely lightweight, no dependencies

Full documentation: https://smartparallax.com/

Available Classes

Class
Description

.parallax-image
Creates a moving background layer

.parallax-container
Moves an entire block or section

.parallax-x
Enables horizontal parallax motion

.parallax-xy
Enables multi-direction parallax

.parallax-(--)
Adjusts speed (e.g. .parallax-05, .parallax--03)

.parallax-[…]-s
Stop-sensitive motion (movement stops after center)

License

SmartParallax is open-source software licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/smart-parallax/,
    or install it via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate SmartParallax.
  3. Add one of the provided CSS classes to any block or container.
sections.faq:
Does SmartParallax use JavaScript?

Yes. It uses a small, dependency-free engine with GPU-accelerated transforms.

Is it compatible with page builders?

Yes. It works with Gutenberg, Elementor, Bricks, Divi, Oxygen, WPBakery and most modern themes.

Will it slow down my website?

No. SmartParallax is extremely lightweight and fully GPU-optimized.
